column4: click "Demod scope"; state scope.demodOpen 0 -> 1 -> 0 -> 1 -> 0
the window opens (state scope.demodOpen, scope.glassW > 500, scope.painted) and its own Close key ("Close"#2) shuts it
click "AUDIO"; state scope.signal == 0, scope.audioCount == 4800
click "SPEC"; state scope.signal == 1, scope.bins > 300, scope.audioCount == 0
click "I/Q"; state scope.signal == 2, scope.iqCount > 1000
click "VECTOR"; state scope.signal == 3, scope.iqCount > 1000

the multiplex key exists only in WFM, which needs a 200 kS/s channel: the fixtures are narrowband (the gather, the marks and the key's refusal are unit-tested in test_slint_host_scope; the key and the marks are rendered in test_slint_scope_modes)
click "Shorter time base"; state scope.timebase == 2, scope.audioCount == 2400
click "Longer time base"; state scope.timebase == 4, scope.centre == "20 ms/DIV", scope.audioCount == 9600
click "Less gain" after unticking AUTO; state scope.gain == "100 mV/DIV"
click "More gain"; state scope.gainIndex == 7, scope.gain == "500 mV/DIV"; disabled while AUTO is ticked and on a spectrum (expect enabled equals "false")
click "AUTO"#3; state scope.auto 1 -> 0 and the steppers become enabled
click "NORM"; state scope.display == 0
click "AVG"; state scope.display == 1
click "PERSIST"; state scope.display == 2, scope.segments > 800
state scope.segments > 300 and scope.painted counts the glass painted at scope.glassW x scope.glassH; shots scope-demod-open.png and scope-demod-persist.png
click "Radar scope"; state view == 2 and scope.radarOn == 1
click "EXIT SCOPE"; state view back to 0
key escape; state view back to 0 (the root FocusScope's shortcut, the keyboard handed to it when the tab opens)
click "Range down"; state scope.range 200 -> 100 -> 50
click "Range up"; state scope.range 50 -> 100
state scope.hasRx == 0 and scope.tubeW == 0 with no position (the empty state), then 1 and > 300 after Set RX here; shot scope-radar-empty.png
state scope.drumTracks == "001" with one aircraft heard

the fixtures have no gain stage, so the knob is dead (state scope.knobDead == 1 is asserted); the detents, the clamps, the local hold and the NaN for a dead knob are unit-tested in test_slint_host_radar; the knob's wheel and drag are in test_slint_scope_modes
click "POWER"; state running 1 -> 0 -> 1
scroll "Radar tube" 120 / -120; state scope.range 100 -> 200 -> 100 (a wheel turned up is one rung down)
the input script has no drag verb; the drag, the 2 px threshold and the swallowed click are asserted in test_slint_scope_modes (real pointer events) and test_slint_host_radar
the input script has no double-click verb; asserted in test_slint_scope_modes and test_slint_host_radar

a click lands at a position the script cannot aim at an aircraft (press "<label>" clicks a control's centre); the hit test is unit-tested in test_slint_host_radar, and a HOME row's click (row 1606) selects the same aircraft
as row 1595: the click on empty glass is unit-tested in test_slint_host_radar
state scope.targets >= 1 and scope.trailPoints >= 1 with the decoded aircraft; shot scope-radar-target.png
click "HOME"; state scope.lcd == 0
click "FLIGHT"; state scope.lcd == 1
click "SYS"; state scope.lcd == 2
click "FOXSDR1" (the HOME row's name); state scope.selected == 4D2025 and scope.lcd == 1
click "PHOSPHOR"; state scope.phosphor 1 -> 0
click "SWEEP"; state scope.sweep 1 -> 0
click "TRAILS" twice; state scope.trail 2 then 0
click "FILTER"; state scope.filter == 1 (scope.plotted == 0) then 2 (scope.plotted >= 1)
state scope.flight contains "35000 FT" after selecting the aircraft; shot scope-radar-flight.png
